name: geoclient
author: hipeace86
description: GeoHelper desktop client built with Next.js and Electron

scripts.dev:client: pnpm run build:electron && cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_MODE=client ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:3002 concurrently -n "NEXT,ELECTRON" -c "yellow,blue" --kill-others "next dev --port 3002" "node scripts/launch-electron.js ."
scripts.dev:client:debug: pnpm run build:electron && cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_MODE=client ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:3002 concurrently -n "NEXT,ELECTRON" -c "yellow,blue" --kill-others "next dev --port 3002" "node scripts/launch-electron.js . --inspect=5858 --remote-debugging-port=9222"
scripts.dev:operator: pnpm run build:electron && cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_MODE=operator ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:3001 concurrently -n "NEXT,ELECTRON" -c "yellow,blue" --kill-others "next dev --port 3001" "node scripts/launch-electron.js ."
scripts.dev:operator:debug: pnpm run build:electron && cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_MODE=operator ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:3001 concurrently -n "NEXT,ELECTRON" -c "yellow,blue" --kill-others "next dev --port 3001" "node scripts/launch-electron.js . --inspect=5858 --remote-debugging-port=9222"
scripts.build:renderer: node scripts/write-build-mode.mjs && next build && node scripts/assert-build-mode.mjs
scripts.build:client:mac: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run build:renderer:client && electron-builder --config electron-builder.client.yaml --mac
scripts.build:client:win: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run build:renderer:client && electron-builder --config electron-builder.client.yaml --win
scripts.build:operator:mac: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run build:renderer:operator && electron-builder --config electron-builder.operator.yaml --mac
scripts.build:operator:win: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run build:renderer:operator && electron-builder --config electron-builder.operator.yaml --win
scripts.api:check: pnpm run api:generate:user && git diff --exit-code -- lib/api/generated/user-openapi.d.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run api:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
